## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

MainActivity — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/MainActivity.kt

## Trigger

Process launch, via the launcher activity declared in each module's manifest — observed on the phone (`app-phone/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` declares `MainActivity`); nothing observes it on the watch (`app-wear/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` declares no activity at all, and no `MainActivity` file exists under `app-wear/src/main/java`).

## Today

`app-phone`'s `MainActivity.onCreate` calls `setContent` with a hardcoded `Greeting("Android")` inside a `Scaffold` — it never reads `PhoneNavigator.current` and never renders `RaceListScreen` or any other phone screen. `PhoneNavigator` itself is correct: it starts its back stack on `PhoneDestination.RaceList` and exposes `current`.

`app-wear` has no root composable at all: no `MainActivity` class exists in the module, and its `AndroidManifest.xml` declares an `<application>` with no `<activity>` element — the module builds and installs but has no launcher entry point. `WatchRaceNavigator` and `WatchDestination` already carry the full navigation rule, including the first-launch choice among `SENSOR_PERMISSION`, `WAITING_FOR_PHONE` and `HOME` (see `WatchRaceNavigator`'s `current` initializer), and the screens they route to already exist (`HomeScreen`, `PreparationScreen`, `MainRacePageScreen`, `ProjectionScreen`, `ControlScreen`, `EndOfRaceScreen`, `SensorPermissionScreen`, `WaitingForPhoneScreen`).

## Expected

On the phone, `MainActivity.onCreate` reads `PhoneNavigator.current` and renders the composable matching the current `PhoneDestination`, instead of the hardcoded `Greeting`.

Second gap — a second, independent bearer, not following from the phone one: `app-wear` needs its own root composable. A `MainActivity` class must be created under `app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear`, declared as the launcher activity in `app-wear/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` (currently missing entirely), reading `WatchRaceNavigator.current` and rendering the screen matching the current `WatchDestination` — including the first-launch branch the navigator already computes between `SENSOR_PERMISSION`, `WAITING_FOR_PHONE` and `HOME`.
